name: General Test Plan Pack
purpose: Create a structured, cross-project test plan defining scope, strategy, scenarios, resources, entry/exit criteria, schedule, risks, and deliverables.
when_to_use: planning testing for a feature, release, or change
defining test strategy, scope, and coverage before execution begins
aligning stakeholders on test priorities, schedule, and responsibilities
establishing entry/exit criteria and risk mitigation for a test cycle
notes: Use the general-test/plan/test-plan.md template for the output structure.
Apply general-test/plan/test-plan-checklist.md as a dedicated quality gate.
Follow general-test/plan/test-plan-workflow.md for step-by-step execution guidance.
This pack focuses on planning. Use general-test-report for reporting executed results.
